skill_name: Compare and contrast the debate between liberalism and traditionalism
workflow: The debate between liberalism and traditionalism revolves around two different perspectives of the world. Liberals favor an expansive view of government involvement, often advocating for increased rights for individuals, more equitable distribution of resources, and the pursuit of progressive social causes.
